definitions.coordinates: z=0 skin surface; +z depth; local phantom X/Y
definitions.target: r<=5mm, z15–20mm with fractional XY area and exact depth overlap
definitions.central_column: r<=5mm fractional XY disk overlap, all depths
definitions.depth_plane_weighting: native represented cell volumes within each actual z plane
definitions.boundary_warning: High E at material interfaces/contact edges is not evidence of deep focusing
definitions.success_status: no deep-focus or convergence success inferred by this audit

bulk_skin_J.definition: native cell vector RMS sqrt(sum_f ||gamma_f E_f||^2/2); volume-weighted P95
bulk_skin_J.conductive_definition: replace complex gamma with Re(gamma); excludes displacement current
bulk_skin_J.skin_definition: SC 0–0.1mm plus dermis 0.1–5.1mm; distinct from depth 0–5mm non-target region
bulk_skin_J.contact_face_J_definition: existing contact J uses I/overlap-area and contact-area-weighted P95; preserved separately
bulk_skin_J.scope: native sampled finite-volume reconstructed E; not converged surface maxima or safety limits

definitions.skin_SC_plus_dermis_power_W: actual modeled skin tissue loss = SC + dermis; excludes interface contact
definitions.contact_power_W: electrode-interface real loss only; excludes SC and dermis
definitions.skin_power_W: LEGACY ALIAS retained verbatim: SC + contact; excludes dermis; not total skin loss
definitions.source_power_W: all four tissue layers + contact + 50ohm source resistor loss
